messages:
incident-bot: 
PAGER: Sev2 - GPU autoscaler failing to scale in us-east-1. Symptom: HPA showing '<unknown>' for custom GPU metric for ~7m, inference request queue ballooning. Paging current on-call.

kevin: on-call ack. Pulling logs and HPA state now.

rachel: dashboards show pending_inference_requests increased from 300 -> 11,500 over 10m. API 429s reported by canaries. Affects shared and mid-tier customers; enterprise lanes still on reserved capacity.

dennis: `kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-worker` -> shows targets `<unknown>/70%`, replicas 6, min 4, max 250. HPA not reacting.

priya: prometheus scrape for metric `inference/gpu_util_pct` returning delayed samples, many with 30s+ scrape latency. Adapter logs show long GC pauses and clients retrying.

ryan: getting adapter pod logs:
```
2026-03-15T11:02:07Z ERROR adapter: failed to query prometheus: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T11:04:10Z WARN adapter: large scrape backlog (4500 metrics)
```

nate: networking team reported high packet drops between prometheus and adapter in the last hour due to iptables rule misfire after a kube-proxy upgrade.

kevin: ok, immediate plan: 1) emergency scale the deployment to absorb queue 2) mitigate noisy scrapes / reduce scrape concurrency 3) restart one prometheus replica to clear backlog 4) throttle non-critical traffic.

rachel: scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-worker -n inference --replicas=120` (using emergency pool). Running.

rachel: scaled to 120. Queue still growing but rate reduced.

priya: lowering prometheus scrape concurrency: updating prometheus configmap to set `scrape_interval` for non-essential jobs to 30s -> 2m and `scrape_timeout` shorter. Pushing patch.

priya: patch applied and reloaded config. Reducing concurrent scrapes should relieve adapter.

ryan: restarting prometheus-replica-2 to clear backlog.

(1m later)

ryan: prometheus restarted; logs show backlog flush and improved scrape latencies.

priya: adapter metrics now showing successful fetches: `adapter_fetch_duration_seconds` 0.12s, `adapter_errors_total` dropping.

dennis: HPA now sees metrics: `kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-worker` shows `55%/70%` and replicas increasing to match demand (120 -> 160).

nate: network team reverted the iptables change that caused drops. They will follow up with a post-change verification step.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2150004321 created. Commander: kevin. Runbook: gpu-hpa-backlog.md

kevin: customer impact: estimated ~4% of requests experienced throttling or 429s for ~12 minutes; majority were non-critical; enterprise customers unaffected. Logging of affected request ids attached to ticket.

rachel: now that HPA is responding, queue dropped from 11.5k -> 2.3k in 9 minutes. Latency for inferences trending back to normal.

priya: root cause hypothesis: after kube-proxy upgrade a bad iptables rule led to intermittent packet loss between prometheus replicas and adapter, causing large scrape backlogs and adapter timeouts. That made HPA report unknown targets and prevented autoscaling.

kevin: temporary mitigations applied: manual scale, decreased scrape concurrency, restarted prometheus, reverted iptables rule, throttled low-priority lanes. Next: create a durable fallback for HPA when custom metrics are unavailable.

ryan: suggest change: HPA fallback policy: if custom metric is `<unknown>` for >60s, fallback to CPU-based HPA or last-known metric for 5m. Also add alerting rule for 'hpa:unknown_targets:count > 0' in alerts.

nate: we'll add a gating check in the kube-proxy upgrade playbook to run connectivity smoke tests for prometheusadapter path.

kevin: assigning follow-ups: ENG-INFRA ticket for HPA fallback (ENGINFRA-457), ENG-PLATFORM ticket for prometheus scrape tuning and alert (ENGPLAT-881), and SRE to add upgrade smoke tests (ENG-SRE-1223). I'll attach logs and prom queries.

ops-bot: Reminder: Handoff in 40m. Please post a short summary before you go off-shift.

kevin: summary for handoff: "Sev2 - GPU autoscaler degraded due to prometheus/adaptor scrape backlog caused by networking rule after kube-proxy upgrade. Actions: manual scale to 120->160, reduced scrape concurrency, restarted prometheus, reverted iptables change, throttled low-priority lanes. HPA metrics restored and autoscaling resumed. Follow-ups: ENGINFRA-457, ENGPLAT-881, ENG-SRE-1223. Monitoring for 60m."

rachel: attaching canary logs and list of affected request ids to the incident ticket.

priya: monitoring shows stable metrics, no new 429 spikes for 15 minutes.

kevin: handing off command to ryan (oncall). Ryan, you're incident commander for the next window. Watch HPA unknown state and queue.

ryan: taking over. I'll keep the runbook updated and coordinate postmortem.

incident-bot: Update: INC-2150004321 - Status: Mitigated -> Observation. Assigned: ryan, priya, nate.

(After 1h)

ryan: final note: acceptance throttling lifted at 12:15Z. HPA fully recovered. Postmortem scheduled; impact confined to non-critical customers. Closing incident monitoring unless regressions appear.
